name: Gulf Shores & Orange Beach Tourism
description: Gulf Shores and Orange Beach are located on Alabama's beautiful Gulf Coast, offering 32 miles of sugar-white sand beaches across three coastal communities. The region features Southern hospitality, award-winning restaurants, diverse accommodations including beachfront condos, resorts, hotels, beach houses, cabins, bed & breakfasts, and RV parks. Visitors can enjoy outdoor adventures including fishing, boating, jet skiing, snorkeling, kayaking, paddleboarding, parasailing, diving, and dolphin cruises. Family-friendly activities include attractions, shopping, golf, nightlife, indoor activities, and hiking at Gulf State Park. The area hosts numerous annual events and festivals, NCAA Beach Volleyball, concerts, holiday events, and summer camps. Responsible tourism initiatives and sustainability practices are promoted throughout the destination.
